academic_requirements: A bachelor's degree in one of the directly eligible Italian classes, or a suitable equivalent foreign qualification.
Graduates from other classes must document at least 30 CFU across the listed physical/mathematical, psychological, economic/statistical, or industrial/information-engineering disciplines.
Any curricular credit deficiencies must be completed before the assessment of personal preparation.
qualification_system_requirements: For a non-Italian qualification, the committee evaluates duration, credits and disciplinary content.
The foreign qualification must grant access to second-cycle study in the education system where it was awarded.
eligible_degree_classes: Other degree classes with the required 30 CFU

required_subject_credits.subject_area: Physical and mathematical sciences; psychological sciences; economics and statistics; industrial and information engineering
required_subject_credits.ssd_or_domain: PHYS-01/A, PHYS-02/A, PHYS-03/A, PHYS-06/A; MATH-01/A, MATH-03/A, MATH-03/B, MATH-04/A, MATH-05/A, MATH-06/A; PSIC-01/A, PSIC-01/B, PSIC-01/C, PSIC-03/A, PSIC-03/B; ECON-01/A, ECON-02/A, ECON-04/A, ECON-05/A, ECON-06/A, ECON-07/A, STAT-01/A, STAT-04/A; ING-INF/05, ING-IND/35
required_subject_credits.notes: Applies to applicants whose degree is not in a directly eligible class; credits may be distributed across one or more listed groups.

language_requirements: English proficiency of at least CEFR B2 is required.
accepted_language_evidence: English-language certificate demonstrating at least CEFR B2
Pre-admission interview used to verify English proficiency
personal_preparation_assessment: A three-member programme committee reviews the submitted documentation and may hold an interview, including online, to verify curricular requirements and scientific and linguistic preparation. Applicants with foreign qualifications are invited to an interview.
ofa_or_remedial_obligations: Curricular integrations must be acquired before the personal-preparation assessment.
The programme offers recommended preparatory crash courses and suggested self-study materials aligned with the applicant's first-cycle background.

interview_details.required: Required for applicants holding a foreign qualification; otherwise may be required by the committee
interview_details.purpose: Verify curricular requirements and scientific and linguistic personal preparation
